## Apply a Custom Style to the {{ControlName}}

The following example demonstrates how to apply a custom style to the `{{RadClassName}}`.

1. Define the {{ControlName}} in XAML:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-styling' />

1. Add the `telerik` namespace:

    ```XAML
    xmlns:telerik="http://schemas.telerik.com/2022/xaml/maui"
    ```

1. Add the style to the page resources:

    <snippet id='{{control-slug}}-styling-implicit' />
